description: A flyable B-52 bomber with a flight model tuned to real B-52H data and the B-52J upgrade (F130 engines, AESA radar). B-52H-style landing gear that swivels and folds into its own wells, a crosswind crab, speedbrakes and a working drag chute; a flight deck with working standby instruments; real-world loadouts in the bay and on the wing pylons (JDAMs, JASSM-ER, LRASM, ALCM, nuclear and cluster weapons) and MALD / MALD-J decoys; exterior lights; liveries. Best with Heavy Aircraft Hangar, which gives it a hangar it fits in.
